bug_info.bug_desc: The exception cause code for illegal instruction (EXC_CAUSE_ILLEGAL_INSN) is incorrectly encoded as {1'b0, 5'd01} (value 1) instead of the correct value {1'b0, 5'd02} (value 2) as specified in the RISC-V Privileged Specification. This causes the core to report an incorrect exception cause when an illegal instruction is detected, leading to wrong trap handler behavior and potential system malfunction.
bug_info.fix_hint: Change the encoding of EXC_CAUSE_ILLEGAL_INSN from {1'b0, 5'd01} to {1'b0, 5'd02} in the exc_cause_e enum definition in rtl/ibex_pkg.sv to match the RISC-V specification.
